concepts.def: European rebirth of classical art, c.1400-1600.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Renaissance (roughly 1400-1600) revived Greek and Roman ideals. Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo and Raphael used linear perspective and anatomical study to make believable, balanced figures and spaces.

The Baroque era of the 1600s — Caravaggio, Rembrandt — turned up the contrast. Strong chiaroscuro, gestures frozen mid-action and rich colour drew the viewer into emotional, often religious narratives.
Impressionism got its name from Monet's painting Impression, Sunrise, shown in 1874 (painted in 1872). Artists worked en plein air with broken brushwork to capture light at a specific moment.
